claim: Do I have to do HoT/PoF story to get access to the new zones ... - Reddit
summary: There are three ways to get to HoT/POF. DO the first two chapters of the story, teleport to a friend, or join a guild with a guild hall in those areas. Any of them will unlock the zones. However I recommend doing the first stories, because that will unlock the masteries you'll want to be working on while playing in that zone.
